description: This Java class 'CashBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan' implements accounting processing for loan transactions in a cash-based accounting system. It handles creation of journal entries for various loan-related activities such as disbursements, repayments, charge-offs, refunds, transfers, chargebacks, and adjustments, utilizing helper services and maintaining detailed accounting logic.

classes.name: CashBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan
classes.description: Main class implementing accounting processing for loan transactions, handling various types of journal entries based on transaction types.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoan
methods.description: Main method to process a LoanDTO and generate appropriate journal entries for each transaction.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForChargeOff
methods.description: Handles journal entries for loan charge-offs, including fraud and fraud expenses.

methods.name: populateCreditDebitMaps
methods.description: Helper to populate credit and debit account maps based on loan product and transaction details.

methods.name: returnExistingDebitAccountInMapMatchingGLAccount

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForChargeAdjustment
methods.description: Handles journal entries for charge adjustments, including charge-off scenarios.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoanChargeAdjustment
methods.description: Creates journal entries for loan charge adjustments.
